request.spec:
A year entry and a button generate the four calendar quarters of that year as periods named
<yyyy>-Q1 to <yyyy>-Q4, each as the period form would add it (a quarter that exists or overlaps is
left out); show how many were made.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A year entry and a button generate the four calendar quarters of that year as periods named
<yyyy>-Q1 to <yyyy>-Q4, each as the period form would add it (a quarter that exists or overlaps is
left out); show how many were made.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The quarterly-periods generator is in, and all 4 Playwright tests pass with `bin/e2e`.

You enter a year and press "Generate quarters", which makes periods named `<yyyy>-Q1` to `<yyyy>-Q4`, each covering three full calendar months. A quarter is left out if its name already exists or its dates overlap an existing period. The others are still made, and the screen shows how many were made. Each period made is recorded in the audit file with the same `PERIOD_ADDED` line the period form writes. If the year isn't four digits (e.g. `x`), the screen shows an error and nothing is made.

What changed:
- **Server**
  - `PeriodService.generateQuarters` does the work. I moved the "skip if taken or overlapping, otherwise save and audit" step that the monthly generator already did into a shared helper, `addUnlessTaken`, so both generators use it.
  - `PeriodController` has a new endpoint, `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/periods/generate-quarters`, which takes `{year}`.
- **Front end** (`periods.ts`): a new small form with `period-generate-quarters-year` and `period-generate-quarters`. It uses the same "Made N" count (`period-generated`) and error (`period-generate-error`) as the monthly and fiscal-year generators, which is what the test expects.

No database change was needed, since quarters are ordinary periods.
